animals.name: African savanna elephant
animals.features: Adult African savanna elephant, very large fan-shaped ears, long relaxed trunk clear of the legs, two curved ivory tusks, four thick legs and a thin tail. Grey wrinkled skin.

animals.name: Northern giraffe
animals.features: Adult northern giraffe, extremely long upright neck, two small skin-covered ossicones, four long distinct legs, short mane and tufted tail. Irregular tan-brown patches separated by pale cream lines.

animals.name: Lion
animals.features: Adult male African lion, natural tawny coat, full brown mane around head and neck, rounded ears, muscular quadruped body, four separate paws, long tail with dark tuft. Calm closed mouth.

animals.name: Cheetah
animals.features: Adult cheetah, slender long-legged body, small head, black tear lines from eyes to mouth, tan coat with small solid black spots, long thick spotted tail with dark rings near tip. Four distinct legs, calm closed mouth.

animals.name: Spotted hyena
animals.features: Adult spotted hyena, powerful broad head, rounded ears, strong shoulders higher than hindquarters, sloping back, four distinct legs, short bushy tail, sandy grey fur with irregular dark spots. Calm closed mouth.

animals.name: Common ostrich
animals.features: Adult male common ostrich, large rounded black feathered body, white wing and tail feathers, long bare pale grey neck, small head and short flat beak, exactly two long bare legs with two toes on each foot, wings folded.

animals.name: Common warthog
animals.features: Adult common warthog, broad flat snout, paired facial pads, curved upper tusks, grey-brown skin, sparse coarse mane along spine, compact body, four distinct legs with cloven hooves, thin tufted tail.

animals.name: Thomson's gazelle
animals.features: Adult male Thomson's gazelle, small slender antelope with tan back, white belly and rump, bold black horizontal flank stripe, two narrow ringed slightly backward-curved horns, facial stripes, four slim legs with cloven hooves.

animals.name: Hippopotamus
animals.features: Adult common hippopotamus, large barrel-shaped body, broad muzzle and closed mouth, small ears and eyes high on head, smooth grey-brown skin with soft pink around eyes and muzzle, four short separate legs, four toes on each foot, short tail.
